answer: An oasis supply market could require a seven-day refundable bond for every active order, whether it buys quartz filters or ivory-colored water tanks. Allocate order capacity by locked value, not account count, so splitting one budget across a thousand keys buys no extra capacity. Bind each reservation to a unique signed order ID and reject reused IDs or collateral already locked elsewhere. Flooding then ties up real capital for a week. This limits cheap Sybil amplification, not wealthy attackers; enforce collateral locks on one shared ledger.
